snippet.title: Super Worms - racing game for MS-DOS (1994)
snippet.description:
Complete playthrough of the DOS game 'Super Worms' by Wiering Software. Super Worms is a 3D racing game inspired by Super Mariokart. In this game you drive your worm around tracks and try to collect items that will help you to win the race. This game can be played by two players (on the same PC). 

This game was created in 1994, written entirely in assembly language.

Contents:
00:07 -- Grand Prix 1
12:37 -- Grand Prix 2
25:34 -- Grand Prix 3
39:51 -- Battle Game

The game is still available: http://www.wieringsoftware.nl/sw/
